script.title: FIRST ACCOUNT
script.story_hook: A first paycheck deserves a first checking account.
script.intro_zh: 剛領第一份薪水,年輕人到銀行開了第一個戶頭。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today: opening a checking account.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎!今天來學銀行開戶的對話。
script.outro: Sixty lines and a brand-new account. Well done!
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,新戶頭也開好了。做得好!
script.practice_intro_en: Time to practice — say each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 練習時間,和我一起唸每句話。
script.char_a_description: an eager young man in his early twenties with short brown hair styled up and a light beard, wearing a gray blazer over a white tee, dark chinos and clean white shoes, lanky build, clutching a job offer letter
script.char_b_description: a poised middle-aged woman with chin-length auburn hair, wearing a charcoal blazer dress over a cream blouse, small gold earrings and low pumps, warm smile, reading glasses on a beaded strap

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to open a checking account.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə ˈoʊpən ə ˈtʃɛkɪŋ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我想開一個支票帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great — first account, or switching?
dialogue.zh: 好啊。第一次開戶,還是從別家轉來?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My first one. I just started work.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fɜrst wʌn aɪ dʒʌst ˈstɑrtəd wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 我的第一個戶頭,剛開始工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exciting! You need it for paychecks?
dialogue.zh: 真棒!是要用來收薪水嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes — a home for my paycheck.
dialogue.zh: 對——讓我的薪水有個安放的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then checking is the right fit.
dialogue.zh: 那開支票帳戶就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I know before signing?
dialogue.zh: 開戶之前,我有什麼要注意的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two things, honestly: fees and balance.
dialogue.zh: 誠實說,兩件事:手續費和帳戶餘額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fees? I'm already nervous.
dialogue.zh: 手續費?我已經開始緊張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep five hundred dollars minimum, or…
dialogue.zh: 帳戶裡最少要留五百塊,不然……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or they charge you monthly?
dialogue.zh: 不然每個月就要收錢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten dollars every month, yep.
dialogue.zh: 每個月十塊,沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oof. Five hundred is a lot…
dialogue.zh: 噢。五百塊好多……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the good news, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過,有好消息喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, tell me the good news.
dialogue.zh: 請說——我愛聽好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Direct deposit makes the fee vanish.
dialogue.zh: 薪資直接轉帳進來,月費就免了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's where my paycheck goes anyway.
dialogue.zh: 反正我的薪水本來就要存進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then zero fees, just like that.
dialogue.zh: 那就完全免手續費,就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Okay, what else do I get?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmæzɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ wʌt ɛls du aɪ ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。好,我還會拿到什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A debit card for shopping.
dialogue.zh: 一張簽帳卡,用來消費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get it today, right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt ɪt təˈdeɪ raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天馬上就能拿到卡嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your card arrives in five to seven days.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr kɑrd əˈraɪvz ɪn faɪv tə ˈsɛvən deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 卡片會在五到七天內寄到你手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That long? I have nothing today.
dialogue.zh: 要那麼久?我今天手上什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can print a quick card now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn prɪnt ə kwɪk kɑrd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以當場先印一張臨時卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please! Does it work everywhere?
dialogue.zh: 太好了!這張卡哪裡都能刷嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In stores and online, but no ATM.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn stɔrz ænd ˈɑnˌlaɪn bʌt noʊ ˌeɪdiːˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 商店和網路刷卡都行,但不能用提款機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. I hardly use ATMs anyway.
dialogue.zh: 成交。反正我很少用提款機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next: do you write checks at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst du ju raɪt tʃɛks ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 下一個問題:你會開支票嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never. Who writes checks anymore?
dialogue.zh: 從不。這年代誰還寫支票呀?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair! Skip the checkbook then.
dialogue.zh: 說得對!那就免去支票本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. What about the account number?
dialogue.zh: 好。那帳號呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts on your temporary card.
dialogue.zh: 你的臨時卡上面就有帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my boss needs a routing number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ bɔs nidz ə ˈrutɪŋ ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 對了,我主管還需要路由號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll email you both numbers today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天會把兩個號碼都用電子郵件發給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Um… one small problem.
dialogue.zh: 完美。呃……有一個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me — maybe it's easy.
dialogue.zh: 說來聽聽——也許很好解決。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I forgot my ID at home.
dialogue.zh: 我的身份證忘在家裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! We do need one ID, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wi du nid wʌn ˈaɪˌdi ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噢!不過我們確實需要一張證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring it tomorrow instead?
dialogue.zh: 那我明天帶來可以嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll keep your paperwork ready.
dialogue.zh: 可以,我會把你的文件先備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — does a passport count?
dialogue.zh: 等等——護照也算嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, yes! A passport works perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 噢,當然!護照完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I carry it — let me grab it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkæri ɪt lɛt mi ɡræb ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我身上帶著——我去拿一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time. Coffee while you go?
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm ˈkɔfi waɪl ju ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來。你要順帶喝杯咖啡嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, quick run! Back in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kwɪk rʌn bæk ɪn ə ˈmɪnət/
dialogue.zh: 不用,我很快就回來!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Meanwhile, here's the application form.
dialogue.zh: 那你回來前先填這張申請表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back! Passport here. Where do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ˈpæspɔrt hɪr wɛr du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 回來了!護照在這。要在哪裡簽名?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom right corner — lovely handwriting!
dialogue.zh: 右下角就好——你的字真漂亮!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! My grandma taught me cursive.
dialogue.zh: 哈!我奶奶教的連筆字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it — you're officially opened.
dialogue.zh: 完成了——你正式有戶頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So cool. Can I use it right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kul kæn aɪ juz ɪt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好酷。我現在就能開始用嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app works before the mail arrives.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp wɜrks bɪˈfɔr ðə mel əˈraɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 銀行應用在卡片寄到前就能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set up direct deposit tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我就來設定薪資直接轉帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And keep an eye on the balance.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kip ən aɪ ɑn ðə ˈbæləns/
dialogue.zh: 然後記得隨時留意餘額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even after the deposit starts?
dialogue.zh: 就算轉帳開始了,也要留意嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less stress, but smart to watch.
dialogue.zh: 壓力會小很多,但看一眼更聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five hundred, one card, zero fees.
dialogue.zh: 五百塊、一張卡、零手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the whole plan, in one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə hoʊl plæn ɪn wʌn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 整份規畫,一句話就說完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Bank days aren't scary.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝!上銀行一點都不可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you soon — bring that paycheck!
dialogue.zh: 很快再見——帶著你的薪水來吧!

"A home for my paycheck!" — that's how a first job starts, and banks hear it every day. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a young man opens his very first checking account: minimum balance rules, the ten-dollar monthly fee, a direct-deposit trick to skip it, an instant temporary card, and a funny run home for a forgotten ID. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. Polite, practical, and packed with real bank-counter English. No memorizing — just listen often.
